items.title: Ann Rabson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 21, 2007
items.q: Bruce Iglauer said, “I will never have a major seven on my label.” And I threw one in.

ctx.x: I’ve done it though. Bruce Iglauer said, “I will never have a major seven on my label.” And I threw one in. Anyway.
What a funny thing to say.
